nominal_clearance_continuity.reason: 12 mm cutter sampling creates scalloping/interpenetration between sampled poses

positive_drive_common_return.note: At sampled cutter stations the trailing -X flank catches a lagging bowl; between cutters some nominal poses intersect the screw.

positive_drive_selected_flip.reason: RETURN swept cavity erases the selected-bowl trailing drive flank in the overlap zone
positive_drive_selected_flip.required_rule: selected bowl must retain positive screw drive until positive-control takeover

transfer_material_reserve.note: Material fraction is a geometry reserve indicator, not a structural stress PASS.

root_causes: Discrete 12 mm envelope sampling is too coarse; phase step is 27 degrees at pitch 160 mm.
Full isotropic 3 mm clearance cutters are too aggressive on the drive side.
Union of RETURN and FLIP cavities removes the selected trailing drive flank around X700-X708.

actions: Use dense/adaptive envelope sampling; target <=4 mm globally and <=2 mm in transfer zone, or a continuous swept construction.
Replace isotropic clearance with asymmetric drive-flank clearance: small trailing clearance and larger leading clearance.
Delay selected/return trajectory divergence while screw positive drive is required.
Preserve a selected trailing lug through the control-overlap region before opening transfer relief.
Re-run exact STEP distance checks and section-material checks before updating the viewer.
